summary: A short biographical note on Loekman Hakim, an Indonesian born in Cianjur, West Java, on December 30, 1975. It covers his parents, his position among five siblings, his father's job as a teacher at SMP 5 Bandung, and his marriage to Rika Nurhayati with two children.
one_line: Biographical note on Loekman Hakim, born 1975 in Cianjur, West Java, with family background and marriage details.
key_facts: Loekman Hakim was born in Cianjur, West Java, Indonesia.
Loekman Hakim was born on December 30, 1975.
His parents were Eman Sulaeman and Iis Martini.
Loekman Hakim is the third child of five siblings.
His father was a teacher at SMP 5 Bandung.
The note states that Loekman Hakim and Rika Nurhayati have two child.
